Westfield State University
Nettie M. Stevens Science & Innovation Center
Westfield, MA
Architect: Cambridge Seven Associates, Inc.

The new building and renovation of the existing building features interactive classrooms and research-quality labs for all science concentrations, along with nursing simulation suites. Construction cost is approximately $37 million. The new center achieved LEED Silver Certification.

title:
Worcester State University Residence & Dining Hall
Worcester, MA
Architect: Goody Clancy
description: Structural Engineering for the 152,000 GSF new building which has 400 beds, a 625 seat dining facility and a 1,600 sf health services center. The structure consisted of both concrete on metal deck with steel framing for the assembly spaces, and precast concrete plank on an upset structural T (d-beam) to create a flat ceiling in the dormitory spaces. This project achieved LEED Gold certification.

title:
Worcester State University Wellness Center
Worcester, MA
Architect: ARC
description: Structural Engineering for the $53M, 103,000 sf new athletic center. The new center features a 1,200 seat multi-purpose competition gymnasium with a 9,000 sf fitness/weight room, a 1,500 sf training room with hydrotherapy pools, 3 aerobics/dance/spinning rooms, 2 general purpose classrooms, a 1,200 sf function room, a student lounge with a juice bar, a golf simulation room and batting cages. This project achieved LEED Gold certification. Limiting the vibration due to aerobic activities was a consideration when designing the structure.
